title: KOLScoreMetric
description: Aggregated KOL engagement metrics and score published by Module 3 (stream-processor) to kol.metrics.kol-scores. Message key = kol_id (compacted topic keeps latest record per KOL).

kol_id.description: <platform>:<native account id> of the KOL being evaluated

handle.description: Latest observed handle or display name if available

followers.description: Latest observed follower count if available

total_events.description: Cumulative events processed for this KOL since processor start

window_events.description: Events observed for this KOL within the active sliding window

window_minutes.description: Duration of the sliding window in minutes

engagement_score.description: Cumulative weighted engagement score for this KOL

window_score.description: Weighted engagement score within the sliding window

velocity_per_min.description: Average window engagement score per minute (window_score / window_minutes)

top_hashtags.description: Most frequent hashtags associated with this KOL

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this score snapshot was emitted
